It’s been two weeks since the storm started. The food stores are dwindling, and we haven’t seen hide nor hair to hunt. Thank goodness I have my Everything a Pioneer Needs Bundle. Each card, foil and non, has proven its utility time and again. They are powerful. They are precious. Although, I am often tempted to sink my hungry teeth into them. But no, we’ll be at the next trading post soon.
Contents:
• 1x Survival-Grade Foils Bundle
• 1x Trail-Ready Non-Foils Bundle
